item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"write\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"work.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Evaluate declared source dependencies for review.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\nimport json\\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, Mapping\\n\\n\\n_MISSING = {\\\"kind\\\": \\\"missing\\\"}\\n\\n\\ndef _canonical_json(value: Any) -> str:\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Return a stable, type-preserving representation of a JSON value.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    return json.dumps(\\n        value,\\n        sort_keys=True,\\n        separators=(\\\",\\\", \\\":\\\"),\\n        ensure_ascii=False,\\n        allow_nan=False,\\n    )\\n\\n\\ndef evaluate(request: Mapping[str, Any], policy: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Return whether any relevant declared source has changed.\\n\\n    Missing entries are treated as the canonical missing-source state. Inputs are\\n    only read and are never normalized or otherwise modified in place.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    ignored = set(policy.get(\\\"ignored\\\", ()))\\n    saved = request.get(\\\"saved\\\", {})\\n    current = request.get(\\\"current\\\", {})\\n\\n    changed = []\\n    for path in set(request.get(\\\"declared\\\", ())):\\n        if path in ignored:\\n            continue\\n        saved_state = saved[path] if path in saved else _MISSING\\n        current_state = current[path] if path in current else _MISSING\\n        if _canonical_json(saved_state) != _canonical_json(current_state):\\n            changed.append(path)\\n\\n    changed.sort()\\n    return {\\\"needs_review\\\": bool(changed), \\\"changed\\\": changed}\\n\"}},{\"action\":\"write\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"report.json\",\"content\":\"[\\n  {\\n    \\\"needs_review\\\": false,\\n    \\\"changed\\\": []\\n  }\\n]\\n\"}}]}"}
